gap: No result ChatGPT got states the price per card slot. From each maker's US store on 2026-11-08: ESR Geo Wallet Boost is $9.25 per card ($36.99 for 4 cards + cash, with Find My and 1,800 g magnet hold), ESR Geo Magnetic Wallet Stand is $9.40 per card, Smartish Wallet Slayer Vol. 1 is $7.50–$10.00 per card, and ESR Geo Wallet Stand (HaloLock) is $15.33 per card because it holds only 3.
standout_why: Two pages loaded. Macworld's iPhone 17 cases guide (cited in one chat) has no wallet pick and no price, card or magnet-strength figures. iPhone iPad Review lists Smartish Wallet Slayer Vol. 1 with only a 'Budget' price tier and a 3-vs-4 card note, so no dollars-per-card figure or hold force. Six rival pages would not load for my fetch tool: Good Housekeeping (cited in two chats), Wirecutter (cited, via a proxy URL), Wired, Esquire, Best Products and Travel + Leisure. I can't rule out that one of them states a per-card cost, but none of the answers ChatGPT gave quotes one. ChatGPT's answers give only raw prices and card counts.
decides: It confirms Smartish Wallet Slayer Vol. 1 ($29.99 on smartish.com) as the cheapest per card if you don't need wireless charging. Among detachable Find My wallets it favours ESR Geo Wallet Boost ($9.25 per card, 1,800 g stated hold) over the ESR Geo Wallet Stand (HaloLock) row now on our page ($15.33 per card, 3 cards at most). That supports demoting the Wallet Stand row or swapping it for the 5-card ESR Geo Magnetic Wallet Stand ($9.40 per card, 3,200 g stated hold).
